notes.title: v4.0 - Deuces Wild!
notes.notes:
Hey Vidya Poker players!
coolnames here!  I missed you guys too!  Here is what included in the 4.0 update:


[h2]Solid and Gradient Color Backgrounds![/h2]

In the Pause Menu, you can now change from the outer-space background to either a solid color or 2 color gradient background!  This can make playing have a more stylized look, utilizing some of your favorite colors.  Slight performance increase as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/67a94670f8fcce4e89a24c940389857bbfc07480.gif[/img]


[h2]Players Can Choose To Fly Through Space![/h2]

After popular request, I implemented a toggle button for 'Moving' through the default outer-space background.  While I prefer the visuals of moving, it is now the player's choice!  Toggle it in the Pause Menu when playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/5673b3340ef36dec56cc42575e165f36e3dd2d0a.png[/img]



[h1]DEUCES WILD VIDYA POKER[/h1]

I decided to challenge myself and dev a new poker gametype:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/763a30bcd9343164ebfaedf9acbdc5c234ce337f.gif[/img]


[h2]Deuces Wild! How does it work?[/h2]
EASY!
[list]
[*] Any 2 (deuce) is wild!  This means, it can represent any other card in the deck. 2s will glow with a rainbow effect!
[*] With wild cards, a 5 of a Kind hand is possible!
[*] Because good hands are easier to earn, payouts are reduced for lower tier scores.
[*] Three new unique hands can be earned in Deuces Wild mode.
[*] Earning a score that includes Aces will still earn Diamonds, just like the other poker modes!
[*] Auto-play is also operational in Deuces Wild!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/312967862e6b3c14b5a3f8a20c415f6d284d94f5.png[/img]

Also, 9 new achievements for Deuces Wild hands have been added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/cffe6a39ccc43eab0bf9a5807156f1a8fd760b41.png[/img]


[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
Of course, as I delve back into the project, I continually find more efficient ways to do logic.  It might be placebo effect (since I haven't used any FPS analysis), but the game feels smoother to me!

[h2]Thank You![/h2]
I know it has been a while since the game has been updated - I am back actively developing!  Thank you for all your positive interaction and reviews! I plan on continually adding content to the game --expect another update this month!


coolnames

notes.title: Vidya Poker 3.1 Released!
notes.notes:
Howdy Vidya Poker players!
coolnames comin' at you with the biggest milestone yet (and a patch)!

[h2]Out of Early Access[/h2]
Finally calling the game released and exiting Steam EA!
I made a short trailer video for the milestone that is also posted on the store page:
[previewyoutube=ZR1f8dWrS10;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Steam Cloud[/h2]
I recently formatted my workstation and on loading up Vidya Poker for the first time, my player stats were not there! Duh, the player progress info was not backed up!

This is no longer an issue for players because Steam Cloud syncing now is working! Playing on any Windows machine through Steam, through the same Steam account, your stats and currency is now persistent!


[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]
Found a glaring bug with scoring that is now fixed! Earning a hand score of a 4 of a Kind 2s, 3s, or 4s *with* an Ace kicker card is now properly paying Diamonds out.


[h2]Thank You![/h2]
Thanks so much to all the players for your support during development!  Everyone plays video games differently and on different hardware, so all your feedback has been extremely helpful!

Phone release incoming! Android first! 🤖

notes.title: Vidya Poker 3.0 Released!
notes.notes:
Hey Vidya Poker players!
coolnames here, and do I have a juicy patch for you all!

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
More than 80% of the code has been rewritten for efficiency and performance.  So much of the code was initially 'hacked' together to get functionality working for the sake of time.  Logic for scoring, stat tracking, and manipulating the objects on screen have all been boiled down to run fast!  Here is an example, green bit on the left is new, red bit on the right is old:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/3a27e2e6a132139ca01ca28fbe9ff828086d7b82.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/de3aeb6805e4cf266bdc857a72efceb4f619f11c.png[/img][/url]

An important step for an Unreal Engine game is the minimization of casting being used.  Casting is basically how objects and variables are linked/shared/communicated between one another when using UE's Blueprints.  Casting in Vidya Poker has been almost completely removed, increasing performance and benefiting memory use.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/b4fa7aed3eb8b2540e49c5cd5779f837ca10cc70.png[/img]

Also, many old assets in the project have been culled.  Even with the addition of new assets in this patch, the overall install size of the game has been reduced!


[h2]Quality Settings for Graphics and Visual Effects[/h2]
For anyone running the game on Skynet or a potato, and everything in between, you can now select any of four Quality presets to get the game running/looking just the way you like!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/fa347bc9cf7b258b6ecb2f3d7d2d0078dd744d88.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/abf5ae7281539b8f0bb8215ccde1f8937172f610.jpg[/img][/url]

At default High, all visuals will have their full, intended fidelity!  As you decrease Quality, visual candy is either reduced or removed. Laptop players should now be able to enjoy Vidya Poker at a good framerate!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/cf776373fe52abeeda49377d29a79501a49302de.gif[/img]

Quality adjusts the following: fire and ice effects, lighting, space background, space clouds, card electricity effects, fireworks, and several UI elements.


[h2]New Stat Tracking[/h2]
Vidya Poker has been using Steam's stat tracking up until this patch.  I have since simplified how stats are tracked to help with adding new content to the game as well as when the game is ported to other platforms.

Because of the change, a player's unlocked customizations they bought with Diamonds are now reset and Diamonds refunded.  On your first launch of the game with patch installed, you will see this screen displaying your refunded diamonds:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/0167286f3a46821874322caad841fcf021876809.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/39b2de365e1b73e53ac08e6245b79c1c9ced2f33.png[/img][/url]


[h2]New Controls[/h2]
Quality can now be changed on-the-fly by pressing the 'Q' key on the keyboard.

But, the best control additions have to be the new Mouse button mappings:
[list]
[*] Right Click to trigger DEAL/DRAW
[*] Thumb Button 1 Click to replicate pressing the 'Esc' key on keyboard or the Back button.
[*] Middle Mouse / Scroll Wheel Click to toggle Auto-Play
[/list]
Using Right Click to DEAL/DRAW has made the game much faster and intuitive to play, imo.  I have been loving playing this way...very fast!


[h2]HOLD/HELD Text Looks Better[/h2]
Text now has a nice contrasting black stroke.  Looks much better now!! Nuff Said!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/5ff32e9893dec68625d2c51683a949e86c9d0c26.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/5f0ef4e0c5c31ef99e383556192bae213dca0402.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Thank You![/h2]
I really appreciate your support while developing this game. More content and tweaks will be coming!!  Be well!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/9c533432022bb24981cdaa8d87c1b8be028101f6.png[/img]



[hr][/hr]


[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]
[h2]Vidya Poker v3.0[/h2]
[h3]6-18-21[/h3]

[b]STATS:[/b]
[list]
[*]New Stat tracking system implemented. All player stats from Steam players are maintained; Spent Diamonds are now REFUNDED when loading the game for the first time. All customization unlocks are reset to default.[/*][*]ACHIEVMENTS ➡ New Achievement added for 'Unlocked All Toons'[/*][*]ACHIEVMENTS ➡ New Achievement added for 'Unlocked All Toon Skins'[/*][/list]
[b]INPUT:[/b]

[b]GRAPHICS:[/b]

[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]

[*]FIXED ➡ Mouse controls are no longer being treated as Touch Input, increasing accuracy and enabling ToolTips to be used for Hover functions.[/*][*]FIXED ➡ Cards no longer fall infinitely when falling after Deal/Draw[/*][*]FIXED ➡ SFX for payouts of coins/diamonds & when purchasing unlocks now play audio clearly and consistently[/*][*]FIXED ➡ Transition time of music tracks between Hot/Cold/Normal has been reduced.[/*][*]FIXED ➡ New Player, Game opens in default Windowed mode.[/*][*]FIXED ➡ New Players now have the correct default Card Back selected on first play[/*][*]FIXED ➡ When returning into gameplay from the Main Menu, when in COLD mode, ice effects are now orientated properly on cards.[/*][*]FIXED ➡ SFX for MainMenu button in Pause UI is now functioning properly.[/*][*]FIXED ➡ Last selected Toon Skin is now maintained even after changing Toons.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Early Access Ending Soon!
notes.notes:
Hey guys and gals!  coolnames here!

I have been working hard on the next big update for Vidya Poker for the past weeks, putting all other projects on hold.

🎊🥳🎉 This next patch will be Vidya Poker leaving 'Early Access' on Steam!!  🎉🥳🎊

New stuff that you should like:
- 2 new card styles to unlock and use
- 30 total card back designs to unlock and use
- Ability to change Graphics Quality (very useful for lower spec'd machines)
- 2 new achievements
- Install size [u]reduced[/u] even after all the additional content
...and lots of optimizations and some bug fixes! 🦶🐛

One very important change is how Stats and Unlocks are tracked/saved.  I have rewritten all the code and moved away from Steam Stat tracking and am now doing the tracking in-game, on the local machine.

[b]What this means is that your [u]current stats, coins, and unlocked toons/skins are going to be reset[/u] when the patch hits. 😲[/b]
Steam Achievements will [u]NOT[/u] be reset.

I could have spent a TON of time writing code to migrate all your data saved on Steam servers to the new system, but I have instead decided to focus on working more on the actual game design and new features!

[b]Vidya Poker Early Access players' current Diamonds will be maintained. All spent Diamonds for unlocks will be refunded to the player. Players can then spend Diamonds on their favorite unlocks right away.[/b]

I hope this is an acceptable compromise as I continually add content and optimization!

When the beta is available to test, I will let you guys know!

As always, any feedback you have, please shoot me a comment or whatever!

-- coolnames

[h2]Auto Play!!![/h2]
Vidya Poker can now play itself!
Clicking the 'AUTO' button or pressing 'A' on the keyboard will toggle Auto Play!
Interacting with the cards or the Deal button will exit Auto Play.
Auto Play logic is as follows:[olist]
[*] Deal a new hand!
[*] If dealt winning hand, hold winning cards. Otherwise, hold specific cards for best chance of rewards.
[*] Draw replacement cards!
[*] Celebrate winnings! (timed)
[*] Repeat!
[/olist]
Card selection rules if dealt a non-winning hand are as follows:[olist]
[*] 4 to a Royal
[*] 4 to a Straight Flush
[*] 3 to a Royal
[*] 4 to a Flush
[*] Pair (other than Jacks or Better)
[*] 4 to a Straight
[*] 2 suited Face Cards (Ace, King, Queen, Jack)
[*] 3 to a Straight Flush
[*] 2 Face Cards
[*] 1 Face Cards
[*] WIPE
[/olist]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/cdacbf0f924653f5ecb33e0b39021c1adf437a68.png[/img]
[h2]Automatically have Steam take screenshots![/h2]
When turned on, this feature will capture a screenshot at the end of a winning hand at a x7 (or greater) multiplier or a hand score above Full House.  Perfect for when using Auto Play!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/b3168c3a3967adaf717058701f0efe7c714ab781.png[/img]
[h2]News & Patch notes viewable in-game![/h2]



I think only one last big update is left while still in Early Access.  Here are the main features planned to be implemented:
[list]
[*] New locations to unlock and play in: mountains, ocean+ island, forest, etc!
[*] Graphics quality / performance options!
[*] Multi-language support! Let me know which should be a priority!
[/list]

See ya then!

notes.title: Vidya Poker ➡ Major Update 2.2 LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h1]Boom! The first big update for Vidya Poker since Early Access release is now live![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/bcf562b176366d24c47190d8e976ea9b388d39d3.gif[/img]
I Hope you have had fun playing...and with the new options and gameplay tweaks, I hope you will like the game even more :D


[h2]Keyboard Support[/h2]
I started implementing keyboard input support for both the menus and during gameplay. Ever closer to the casino/bartop way to physically play! 
- The Escape key will either toggle the Pause menu or back you out of any sub-menu you are in.
- The 1 through 5 keys will toggle selection of the respective playing card.
- Space/Enter keys will trigger the Deal/Draw button.


[h2]Video Options[/h2]
There are now Video options available to be changed from both the Main Menu as well as when the game is Paused!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/3f3ba4b6b8e3537a24bb67c02dd910c10ba724bc.png[/img]


[h2]Earn more Diamonds and Coins[/h2]
I made some changes to increase how much currency is earned ...that should make playing more fun!
- Hot Streaks now award the player additional Diamonds and Coins using a Multiplier that increases per win while Hot!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/4038862945de3197af7ad7434f2b87ae09a16018.png[/img]
Example:
Hot multiplier = 3
Winning hand payout = 1
Total Diamond payout is 3 x 1 = 3
Total Coin payout is 3 x 25 = 75


- During a Hot Streak, if a winning hand as Aces, the Hot multiplier is increased +1 for the Diamonds calculated. Now Aces always provide an additional bonus no matter the Hot status.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/38fe80afbb2258679e733b74fcc10a8297f127d0.png[/img]
Example:
Hot multiplier = 2
Winning hand payout = 1
Total Diamond payout is 2 x (1 + 1) = 4
Total Coin payout is 2 x 25 = 50


- When not in a Hot Streak, a winning hand with Aces will award the player in Diamonds equal to that of the payout multiplier for that hand.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/e0ea0dfc4d051fde57252baafaefd87946bfc600.png[/img]



That's all Folks! ...for now! Still adding features! (further animations for Hot and Cold streaks, graphics quality selection, etc).  Have fun!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/9c533432022bb24981cdaa8d87c1b8be028101f6.png[/img]

notes.title: Vidya Poker Early Access Released!
notes.notes:
[h2]After what seems like eons of time, Vidya Poker is finally released to the public in Early Access![/h2]

[h3][b]Hey, I'm coolnames ^_^[/b][/h3]

Vidya Poker is my 2nd game I have released but it was my first game that I began working on.  It started out as a programming challenge to properly simulate video poker rules with a 52 card deck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/c9c6ce92a803bb9d1601d85bddd3311d15f57e31.png[/img]


After I got the scoring logic working, I was having fun enough just testing the game, that I decided to try to zazz it up a bit and add more functionality:
[list]
[*]Betting of money and being paid out with video poker multiplier rules.
[*]Added firework explosions = to the payout multiplier.
[*]Animated sky background.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/5282aefdd6ccfcbf9769ffd5dddccfce78047ffc.png[/img]


Next, I added different video poker rule-sets that the player can choose to modify payouts. I also started testing changing the amount of money bet per hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/ee64c885c529148c959ba40337fb8b0a3c9e5cc7.png[/img]


I started learning about how to use light in-engine with emissive materials and post processing effects. I really like the colors on this....might revisit :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/19ffe65682626ecf3cddc3325508a1dcbfa89d3a.png[/img]


I photoshoped a larger version of the card faces. This was a request of my grandmother, so that she could read the cards better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/b4b3ea37ab3723edebab111e7f16dd14110c482a.png[/img]


I had an idea of adding a little character to the UI that would animate depending on how well the player's hands end up.  I think it is a nice addition to add more visual cues on to how well you are playing.

Winning and losing multiple times in a row can be a rollercoaster of excitement or frustration, and I wanted to show that visually. Enter -> Fire and Ice effects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/59b63e20e49a8a0db62142e0c5df4dc0ef8764ff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/f72419a3118494aa1b8fb44532e583c8f86c6f6e.png[/img]


After doing performance testing and looking at how big the project size on disk was getting, I decided to make the gameplay map a bit more simple, but as colorful as possible. I settled on a space skybox with space clouds throughout that the player flies through.

I also added more little Toon characters as options for the player to pick!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/a0635ef8544ffd5227bb14bb49c4572866eeaab0.png[/img]


And now, here we are, at the version 2.1.1 public early access release of Vidya Poker!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/0a14c49fb17485f663efab618c7bee2e03b52bc8.png[/img]


My last great achievement before releasing to early access was all the stat tracking and Steam Achievements I implemented.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/d616d9b3734a91ac00fafd81f1a22118d63b61af.png[/img]

60+ achievements for earning winnings hands, hot streaks, total money/diamonds and unlocking toons and skins!

Well, it all has been a ton of work, but I really am happy with what Vidya Poker has become...and I hope you have fun playing it!  I will continue to push updates and make the game more robust, so keep an eye out!

Here's to a great 2021!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/9c533432022bb24981cdaa8d87c1b8be028101f6.png[/img]
